description: exp513 backbone (matmul-free LUT, hard everywhere) + VQ VocabLUT unembedder (transposed LUT: tokens address m sub-codebooks, x fills tables; logits dense, V-side matmul-free). Learned VQ codes (STE + commitment) end-to-end from scratch so the backbone co-adapts. m=48 b=8 sub=8 -> ~26x head compression. vs exp513 Linear 1.4825/1.4656; offline-PQ floor at this ratio: m=96 +0.13, m=48 +0.37, m=192 +0.034.
